device.description: 10-bit 40 MSPS pipelined ADC with internal/external reference, power-down and tri-state CMOS parallel outputs (3 V / 5 V output driver supply)
device.note: ads822.pdf (SBAS069B) p.2-3 specifications (digital inputs: convert on the rising clock edge, VIH 3.5 V (CMOS); straight offset binary; 3-state enable 40 ns / disable 10 ns max; +VS 4.75-5.25 V; VDRV 3 V or 5 V), p.4 pin configuration and descriptions, timing diagram (t2 new data delay 12 ns max, 5-clock latency), p.8 theory of operation (data valid on the rising clock edge), p.12 digital outputs, VDRV, Tables I-II coding

pages: p.2-3 (specifications), p.4 (pinout, pin descriptions, timing diagram: t2 12 ns), p.8 (theory of operation), p.12 (digital outputs, VDRV, Tables I-II)
notModeled: analog input and reference; the result is always the 0 V differential (bipolar zero) code 200h, straight offset binary
RSEL (input range 1 V / 2 V) and INT/EXT (internal/external reference) straps only change the analog range; they are stored nowhere (internal pull-ups: open = 2 V range, external reference per p.11)
pipeline latency of 5 clock cycles (the code is constant)
clock period / duty-cycle limits (25 ns to 100 us) and aperture delay

two supplies: +VS 4.75-5.25 V (analog core and CLK/OE/PD inputs) and VDRV (output drivers, 3 V or 5 V logic); vcc is the union 3.0-5.25 V and +VS is listed under analog so VDRV is the digital supply; the ADS822 CLK input needs VIH 3.5 V (5 V CMOS), not reachable from 3 V logic
3-state enable time (40 ns max) differs from the disable time (10 ns); tFloat uses the disable time; internal 50 kOhm pull-down on OE
PD power-down (HI = power down): modeled as the powerdown pin; the datasheet does not state the output state while powered down
pin 24 is the complementary input (IN with an overbar in the datasheet); both inputs are named IN
variants: ADS822 and ADS825 share ads822.pdf and the pinout; the ADS825 accepts a +3 V clock input (TTL / 3 V-5 V CMOS digital inputs, VIH 2.0 V), the ADS822 needs CMOS 5 V levels (VIH 3.5 V)
